verdict.rationale: Tavily is a web-access API, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring searches, crawls, or monitors, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents scheduling. The research endpoint's async request ID and status retrieval covers a single one-off task, not a recurring schedule. Any cron-style automation would have to be built by the user outside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
